summary: This note describes Law of the Plainsman, a Western television series starring Michael Ansara. It aired on the NBC television network for one season, from October 1, 1959, until May 5, 1960.
one_line: Law of the Plainsman was a 1959-1960 NBC Western television series starring Michael Ansara.
key_facts: Law of the Plainsman is a Western television series.
The series aired on the NBC television network.
The series first aired on October 1, 1959.
The series last aired on May 5, 1960.
